gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-syriac-wester: Amatic SC draws spindly, squeezed-toothpaste lines with terminals that stop well short of the stem. Noto Sans Syriac Western is the sturdier voice, its small letters thick and cabled, where the heading is best at being quirky and rustic.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Rustic and quirky, Amatic SC writes in one unwavering pen line with no thick or thin shifts at all. Noto Sans Tagalog adds generous curve gaps and a dominant middle zone.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-tagbanwa: Hand-lettered and wiry, Amatic SC keeps stems and crossbars at one thickness. Noto Sans Tagbanwa follows with open curves and lowercase filling most of the height; a bigger size gives the heading room to breathe.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Noto Sans Tai Le brings neutral, approachable strokes that taper out before touching, with barely any step from capital to lowercase beside Amatic SC's casual hand. Long paragraphs should feel gentle and unfussy.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Skinny pen-drawn lettering with a chalky, rustic mood, all in one fixed stroke thickness from Amatic SC. Noto Sans Tai Tham keeps a long read comfortable, its lowercase crowding the capital line while every round counter stays clearly open.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Amatic SC has an unshaded line that never swells, like handwriting done with a marker. Noto Sans Tai Viet takes over for reading, with short ascenders and a tall x-height; a larger size suits the heading.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-takri: Quirky and hand-drawn, Amatic SC gives every line a signage-like plainness in its weight. Noto Sans Takri uses a high-waisted lowercase with generously unclosed rounds, so text can stay modest in size.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Amatic SC writes in a steady, rustic pen line whose width never changes, terminals stopping far from the stem. And Noto Sans Tamil reads as magnified text, so a long passage feels large and easy going.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-tamil-supplem: Scrappy, spindly and handmade, Amatic SC makes its o a ring with a constant wall. Noto Sans Tamil Supplement is stockier, and the heading earns its keep when big and brief.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Noto Sans Tangsa opens its round letters wide and keeps ascender stems short, beside Amatic SC's pipe-like, hand-drawn strokes. Their strongest quality is the friendly gap between scrawl and sense.
